description:
Amarotto Swimwear is a Colombian luxury swimwear brand that embodies elegance, authenticity, and social responsibility. Each piece is meticulously handcrafted by skilled Colombian artisans using ancestral techniques like crochet and macramé, combined with modern designs and high-quality fabrics.

We offer a curated collection of bikinis, one-piece swimsuits, and beachwear designed to empower women and make them feel confident and beautiful. Our designs are inspired by the vibrant colors and textures of Colombia, and each piece tells a story of artistry, heritage, and social impact.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Handcrafted Luxury: Each Amarotto swimsuit is a unique work of art, meticulously handcrafted by skilled Colombian artisans.
  • Social Impact: We partner with local communities to provide fair wages and support sustainable practices.
  • Colombian Heritage: Our designs celebrate the rich cultural heritage of Colombia, incorporating traditional techniques and vibrant colors.
  • Empowerment: We believe in empowering women to embrace their individuality and express their unique style through our swimwear.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission: 10% on all sales
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid out on a monthly basis via bank transfer.
  • Minimum Payout: $50
  • Tracking: Sales are tracked through unique affiliate links provided by UpPromote.

Other Information:

  • Marketing Materials: We provide our affiliates with high-quality images, banners, and promotional materials to support their marketing efforts.
  • Support: Our dedicated affiliate team is available to answer any questions and provide assistance.
  • Community: Join our exclusive affiliate community to connect with other Amarotto ambassadors and share best practices.

Become an Amarotto ambassador today and share the beauty of handcrafted Colombian luxury with your audience! Sign up now and start earning commissions while making a positive impact.
